items.prompt: After each iteration, which invariant describes the worked quantity loop?
items.explanation: The total and rejection count describe all records processed so far, not future records and not merely the last value.

options.text: Total is the sum of positive values processed so far
options.why: This states the accepted-total invariant after every prefix.

options.text: Total always equals only the most recently processed value
options.why: The loop accumulates accepted values rather than replacing the total.

options.text: Total already includes positive values not yet processed
options.why: A sequential loop has not evaluated those future records.

options.text: Total includes all processed values, regardless of sign
options.why: That would include quantities rejected by this policy.
